items.html: And the matter is, as is known, that from the Tifferet of Ima a crown is made for ZA; and when she too ascends up to there, and her crown will be in the Tifferet of Ima like his, their crowns will be equal, and they will both be one, for both will be the aspect of the Tifferet of Ima, which is a single Sefira. Then she will not need to receive her illumination through ZA, but they will both receive their illumination from Ima, each one by himself, and they will not need one another; and ZON will be equal in their existence, like AVI, as mentioned in the Idra: “AVI come out as one and dwell as one.” And this is the limit of her growth, and then all the worlds are at the ultimate correction.
